source_title: We Finally Found the Flesh Lily Yu'er Needs in Phantom Blade Zero - GameRant
source_excerpt:
While exploring the first few areas of the Weeping Creek Valley in Phantom Blade Zero , you will encounter Yu'er in a cutscene. She will explain to Soul that she came here from Pangzhen and that her father is sick.
Yu'er is searching for a medicinal recipe that can cure her father's illness, but it requires a specific flower. Ask her how to cure her father, and she will tell Soul about the Flesh Lily , starting the quest. This guide covers the location of the flower and the next steps required to complete Yu'er's quest.
Where to Find the Flesh Lily for Yu'er in Phantom Blade Zero
After meeting Yu'er in Weeping Creek Valley, you can check the quest tab to see the Flesh Lily quest. However, unlike some other quests, you will not be able to track it or see where you need to go next.
You can meet Yu'er again at the Outpost after defeating the Peng Meng boss. Here, she will ask you to gather herbs so she can create medicine for the wounded. This starts a separate quest that is unrelated to the Flesh Lily. Speaking to her at the Outpost will not advance the Flesh Lily quest, so you can ignore this request for now and continue progressing through the main story .
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
Your next objective is the Sha-Chi Tower . Go past the locked door that unlocks the eastern part of the region, and once you reach the Valley Sha-Chi Tower 1st Floor Bell, you will normally need to head up the tower to continue the main story. Instead, go up the stairs and turn right. Head to the far-right corner of this area to find a bridge leading down.
Step onto the bridge, and Soul will begin sliding down a long path toward an area where several enemies are fighting each other. Deal with the enemies, then continue toward the upper-left side of the area to trigger a cutscene.
This introduces an optional boss fight against Hua, Deadly Betrothed , who is particularly challenging this early in the game. You can explore the rest of the region before returning to fight her after unlocking more skills. However, the fight ultimately comes down to learning her attack patterns and understanding which attacks you need to parry and when you should dodge or run away.
Defeating Hua rewards you with the Scarlet Wraithblade . After the fight, interact with the corpses near the Bell to obtain the Twin Flesh Lilies . Once you have the flowers, return to the Outpost and give the Flesh Lily to Yu'er.
How to Complete Yu'er's Flesh Lily Quest
After handing Yu'er the Flesh Lily, your next objective will be to escort her home once you reach Pangzhen. For now, continue progressing through the main story until you arrive at the Thieves' Camp in the Crimson Forest , where you will encounter Yu'er again.
During this meeting, she will mention the wounded people in the forest and give you another quest involving treating injured people at multiple locations throughout the Crimson Forest. This is a separate quest and is not directly related to the Flesh Lily, but you can complete it for a free accessory.
Keep in mind that if you want to complete this additional quest, you must do so before defeating the final boss of the second region. Otherwise, the quest will fail.
Continue progressing through the story, and you will eventually meet Yu'er again in Pangzhen. Some time later, you will also meet her father at her home. Once this interaction ends, Yu'er's Flesh Lily quest will be complete.
